title: Copy the output of a command to the clipboard
summary: Pipe the result of any command into pbcopy to copy its output to your clipboard for easy pasting.

aliases.text: скопировать вывод команды в буфер обмена

steps.explain: Run a command and pipe its standard output to pbcopy, which copies the result to the clipboard.

placeholders.name: COMMAND
placeholders.description: The command whose output you want to copy.
